रांची में अगले पांच दिनों में 3-4 डिग्री तापमान गिरेगा।
सुबह और देर रात ठंड का असर बढ़ने की उम्मीद है।
घाटी क्षेत्रों में कुहासे और धुंध का असर दिखने लगा है।
जागरण संवाददाता, रांची। राजधानी रांची समेत आसपास के जिलों में अगले पांच दिनों में 3 से 4 डिग्री तक तापमान गिरने की संभावनाएं जताई जा रही है। जिससे सुबह और देर रात ठंड का असर बढ़ेगा। पूरे राज्य में मौसम का मिजाज धीरे-धीरे बदलने लगा है।
रांची के आसपास घाटी क्षेत्रों में कुहासे और धुंध का असर भी दिखने लगा है। मौसम विज्ञान केंद्र रांची से जारी पूर्वानुमान में बताया गया है कि अगले पांच दिनों के दौरान राज्य के न्यूनतम तापमान में 3 से 4 डिग्री सेल्सियस तक गिरावट आने का अनुमान है।
इससे सुबह और रात के समय ठंड बढ़ेगी। मौसम केंद्र रांची के अनुसार, 6 से 8 नवंबर तक राज्य के अधिकांश हिस्सों में सुबह हल्का कोहरा या धुंध छाने के बाद आसमान मुख्यतः साफ रहेगा। पिछले 24 घंटे की बात करें तो राजधानी रांची में 5 नवंबर को न्यूनतम तापमान 18 डिग्री रहा, जबकि 6 से 8 नवंबर तक न्यूनतम तापमान 17 डिग्री सेल्सियस रहने की संभावना है।
इस दौरान अधिकतम तापमान 27 से 28 डिग्री के बीच रह सकता है। पिछले 24 घंटे के दौरान जगन्नाथपुर में सबसे अधिक 31.7 डिग्री और लातेहार में सबसे कम 15.3 डिग्री सेल्सियस तापमान दर्ज किया गया।
रांची में अधिकतम तापमान 27.6 और न्यूनतम 19.4 डिग्री, जबकि जमशेदपुर में अधिकतम 31.6 और न्यूनतम 24.1 डिग्री सेल्सियस रहा। वहीं, पश्चिमी सिंहभूम के मझगांव में सर्वाधिक 29.8 मिमी वर्षा दर्ज की गई।
पूर्वी सिंहभूम के बहरागोड़ा में 16.6 मिमी, डुमरिया में 16.4 मिमी और पोटका में 2.8 मिमी वर्षा हुई। वहीं, रांची और जमशेदपुर में वर्षा नहीं होने के बाद मौसम सामान्य बना हुआ है।

सुबह और शाम हल्की ठंडक का एहसास होने लगा।
पेड़-पौधों और घास पर ओस की बूंदें दिखाई दीं।
आने वाले सात दिनों में ठंड का असर बढ़ेगा।
जागरण टीम, लखनऊ। नवंबर की शुरुआत के साथ ही मौसम का मिजाज बदलने लगा है। सुबह और शाम के समय हल्की ठंडक महसूस होने लगी है। सुबह घरों से निकलने वाले लोगों को हल्की धुंध और ठंडी हवाओं का एहसास हो रहा है। वहीं, पेड़-पौधों और घास पर ओस की बूंदें भी दिखाई देने लगी हैं।
मौसम में आए इस बदलाव ने गुलाबी ठंड की दस्तक का अहसास करा दिया है। बुधवार को लखनऊ में अधिकतम तापमान 31.4 डिग्री सेल्सियस और न्यूनतम तापमान 17.8 डिग्री सेल्सियस दर्ज किया गया है।
प्रादेशिक मौसम केंद्र के अनुसार, सुबह के समय कई इलाकों में हल्की धुंध छाई रही। राजधानी लखनऊ समेत प्रदेश के कई जिलों में न्यूनतम तापमान में धीरे-धीरे गिरावट दर्ज की जा रही है। राज्य में सबसे अधिक अधिकतम तापमान झांसी में 33.0 डिग्री सेल्सियस दर्ज किया गया।
वहीं, सबसे कम न्यूनतम तापमान हरदोई में 14.0 डिग्री सेल्सियस और मुजफ्फरनगर में 15.0 डिग्री सेल्सियस दर्ज किया गया, जिससे सुबह और रात के वक्त हल्की ठंड महसूस हो रही है। वहीं, कुछ जिलों में सुबह के समय हवा में नमी का स्तर 98 प्रतिशत तक दर्ज किया गया।

इसके चलते सुबह हल्की सिहरन महसूस हो रही है। आने वाले सात दिनों में ठंड का असर और बढ़ने की संभावना है। 10 नवंबर तक प्रदेश के पश्चिमी और पूर्वी उत्तर प्रदेश में मौसम सामान्य रहने की संभावना है।

वीटीवी के मौसम पूर्वानुमान के अनुसार, आज रात (5 नवंबर) से शुक्रवार (6 नवंबर) तक, पूर्व की ओर बढ़ने वाला एक शीत मोर्चा उत्तर की ओर बढ़ेगा, लेकिन इससे मौसम की स्थिति और तापमान में कोई खास बदलाव नहीं आएगा।
फिर, रविवार शाम (8 नवंबर) से सोमवार (9 नवंबर) तक, एक अधिक शक्तिशाली शीत मोर्चा आगे बढ़ेगा, जिससे उत्तर में छिटपुट गरज के साथ बारिश और ठंडा मौसम आएगा।
हनोई में आज तापमान 31 डिग्री सेल्सियस है। 6 नवंबर तक, जब एक कमजोर शीत मोर्चा आएगा, तो तापमान गिरकर 30 डिग्री सेल्सियस हो जाएगा।
9 नवंबर तक, जैसे-जैसे ठंडी हवा का झोंका तीव्र होता गया, दिन भर बादल छाए रहे और बारिश होती रही, तापमान 7-8 डिग्री से गिरकर 23 डिग्री तक पहुंच गया। मौसम में अचानक ठंड काफी बढ़ गई।
दक्षिणी क्षेत्र में, दोपहर और शाम के समय कुछ ही स्थानों पर गरज के साथ बारिश होगी। सुबह से दोपहर तक मौसम धूपदार रहेगा। बेन थान वार्ड और अन्य वार्डों में अधिकतम तापमान आमतौर पर 32-34 डिग्री सेल्सियस के बीच रहेगा।
दक्षिण मध्य क्षेत्र में आज बारिश में कमी आई है। दोपहर में धूप खिली रहेगी और तटीय क्षेत्रों से लेकर पहाड़ी इलाकों तक तापमान 30-33 डिग्री सेल्सियस के बीच रहेगा। दोपहर बाद प्लेइकू, कोन तुम और न्हा ट्रांग जैसे कुछ क्षेत्रों में गरज के साथ बारिश हो सकती है।
उत्तर मध्य क्षेत्र में, थान्ह होआ से लेकर ह्यू शहर तक, सुबह से दोपहर तक मौसम धूप वाला रहेगा और अधिकतम तापमान 32-32 डिग्री सेल्सियस रहेगा।

articles.title: एक शक्तिशाली शीत मोर्चा आगे बढ़ रहा है, जिससे हनोई और उत्तरी वियतनाम में तापमान में तेजी से गिरावट आएगी। - Vietnam.vn

एक शक्तिशाली शीत मोर्चा आगे बढ़ रहा है, जिससे हनोई और उत्तरी वियतनाम में तापमान में तेजी से गिरावट आएगी।
(दान त्रि अखबार) - विशेषज्ञों के अनुसार, उत्तरी क्षेत्र में 8-9 नवंबर के आसपास एक शक्तिशाली शीत मोर्चे का आगमन होगा। इस शक्तिशाली शीत मोर्चे के आने से हनोई और उत्तरी क्षेत्र के मौसम में उल्लेखनीय परिवर्तन देखने को मिलेगा।
5 नवंबर को, डैन त्रि अखबार को दिए एक साक्षात्कार में, मौसम विज्ञान, जल विज्ञान, पर्यावरण और समुद्री विज्ञान संस्थान के मौसम विज्ञान और जलवायु अनुसंधान केंद्र के उप निदेशक डॉ. ट्रूंग बा किएन ने कहा कि अक्टूबर में असामान्य रूप से उच्च तापमान के बाद, उत्तर 8-9 नवंबर के आसपास एक मजबूत शीत मोर्चे का स्वागत करने की तैयारी कर रहा है।
श्री कीन के अनुसार, इसे इस शीत ऋतु की पहली महत्वपूर्ण शीत लहर माना जा रहा है, जिसमें मौसम अपेक्षाकृत गर्म से ठंडा हो गया है और तापमान में बहुत बड़ा उतार-चढ़ाव (तापमान में बहुत तेजी से गिरावट) आया है।
विशेषज्ञ ने बताया कि अक्टूबर में उत्तरी वियतनाम का औसत तापमान पिछले कई वर्षों के औसत से लगभग 2-3 डिग्री सेल्सियस अधिक था। पूरे देश में अक्टूबर का औसत तापमान 26.3 डिग्री सेल्सियस तक पहुंच गया, जो पिछले कई वर्षों के औसत से 1.74 डिग्री सेल्सियस अधिक था और 1961 के बाद से इसी अवधि का उच्चतम तापमान था।
श्री कीन के अनुसार, तापमान बढ़ाने वाले बेहद मजबूत अल नीनो के संदर्भ में, प्रारंभिक मौसम की ठंडी हवाओं की गतिविधि आम तौर पर सामान्य से कमजोर होती है, इसलिए इस मजबूत शीत मोर्चे के आने से मौसम में काफी ध्यान देने योग्य परिवर्तन होंगे।
आपको यह भी पसंद आ सकता है
श्री कीन ने कहा कि मौजूदा आकलन के अनुसार, 5-6 नवंबर को आए कमजोर शीत मोर्चे के बाद, 8-9 नवंबर के आसपास उत्तरी वियतनाम में ठंडी हवा का एक मजबूत झोंका आएगा, जिससे बारिश, बौछारें और गरज के साथ तूफान आएगा, और साथ ही तापमान में तेजी से गिरावट आएगी।
मौसम पूर्वानुमान के अनुसार, उत्तरी वियतनाम और उत्तर मध्य वियतनाम में न्यूनतम तापमान आमतौर पर 16-19 डिग्री सेल्सियस के आसपास रहेगा, जबकि उत्तरी वियतनाम के कुछ पहाड़ी क्षेत्रों में तापमान 13 डिग्री सेल्सियस से नीचे भी जा सकता है। मौसम ठंडा हो जाएगा और पहाड़ी क्षेत्रों में तापमान शून्य से नीचे गिर जाएगा।
विशेष रूप से हनोई में, श्री किएन ने भविष्यवाणी की है कि लगभग 9 नवंबर के आसपास मौसम में उल्लेखनीय ठंड पड़ने की संभावना है, साथ ही बारिश और उत्तर-पूर्वी हवाएं भी चलेंगी। इस दौरान न्यूनतम तापमान 18-20 डिग्री सेल्सियस के आसपास रहने का अनुमान है, जो रात और सुबह के समय गिरकर 18 डिग्री सेल्सियस तक हो सकता है। सबसे ठंडे दिनों में दिन का तापमान आमतौर पर 22-25 डिग्री सेल्सियस के आसपास रहेगा।
विशेषज्ञ ने कहा कि तापमान में अपेक्षाकृत तेजी से गिरावट, बारिश और हवा के साथ मिलकर, लोगों को शुरुआती मौसम की ठंड का अधिक स्पष्ट रूप से एहसास करा सकती है, खासकर रात और सुबह के समय।
आपको यह भी पसंद आ सकता है
हालांकि अल नीनो और जलवायु परिवर्तन के प्रभाव के कारण इस सर्दी के कई वर्षों के औसत से अधिक गर्म रहने का अनुमान है, लेकिन विशेषज्ञ का मानना है कि इसका मतलब यह नहीं है कि भीषण ठंड नहीं पड़ेगी।
श्री कीन के अनुसार, यह सर्दियों के मौसम की एक उल्लेखनीय विशेषता भी है: पूरे मौसम में औसत तापमान सामान्य से अधिक हो सकता है, लेकिन फिर भी तापमान में अचानक गिरावट के अल्पकालिक दौर की संभावना बनी रहती है।
विशेषज्ञ ने लोगों को, विशेष रूप से बुजुर्गों, छोटे बच्चों और श्वसन संबंधी बीमारियों से पीड़ित लोगों को, गर्म रहने पर ध्यान देने की सलाह दी, खासकर जब तापमान में अचानक परिवर्तन होता है।

आगरा में सुबह छाई धुंध, दिन में साफ रहेगा मौसम: रात के तापमान में गिरावट, बढ़ रहा ठंड का असर
Agra weather forecast, temperature drop, winter updates, fog alert. Follow Dainik Bhaskar Latest Updates. आगरा में गुरुवार सुबह से धुंध छाई हुई है। तड़के ठंड का असर बना हुआ है।
आगरा में गुरुवार सुबह से धुंध छाई हुई है। तड़के ठंड का असर बना हुआ है। रात के तापमान में लगातार कमी आ रही है। धूप में नरमी और हवा शांत रहने की वजह से तापमान में और गिरावट आएगी। दिन में मौसम साफ रहेगा। मौसम विभाग के पूर्वानुमान के मुताबिक, 10 नवंबर तक मौसम ऐसा ही रहेगा। बीच में कुछ समय के लिए बादल छा सकते हैं, तेज हवाएं चल सकती हैं। मगर, बारिश या बूंदाबांदी के आसार नहीं हैं। गोवर्धन पूजा तक मौसम साफ रहेगा। अधिकतम तापमान 31 डिग्री और न्यूनतम तापमान 17 डिग्री सेल्सियस के आसपास रहने का अनुमान है। सुबह-शाम ठंड का असर बना रहेगा।मौसम में बदलाव के साथ ही तापमान में उतार-चढ़ाव बना हुआ है। दिन के तापमान में कमी के बाद एक बार फिर से बढ़ोतरी हुई है। हालांकि रात के तापमान का गिरना जारी है। मंगलवार के मुकाबले बुधवार को अधिकतम तापमान में 0.
5 डिग्री सेल्सियस की बढ़ोतरी दर्ज की गई है। वहीं, न्यूनतम तापमान में 0.7 डिग्री सेल्सियस की गिरावट आई है। मौसम विभाग की रिपोर्ट के अनुसार, बुधवार को अधिकतम तापमान 31.8 डिग्री सेल्सियस रहा, जबकि मंगलवार को 31.3 डिग्री सेल्सियस था। वहीं, न्यूनतम तापमान मंगलवार के 17.4 डिग्री सेल्सियस के मुकाबले गिरकर 16.7 डिग्री सेल्सियस पर आ गया।मौसम विभाग के पूर्वानुमान के मुताबिक, आगरा में शुक्रवार को भी मौसम साफ रहेगा। दिन में आसमान में साफ रहेगा। बूंदाबांदी या बारिश के आसार नहीं हैं। कुछ देर के लिए बादल छा सकते हैं। सुबह हल्की धुंध जरूर छा सकती है। 10 नवंबर तक ऐसा ही मौसम रहेगा। बीच में तेज हवाएं चल सकती हैं। मौसम विशेषज्ञों का कहना है कि हवा चलने के कारण तापमान में उतार-चढ़ाव जारी रह सकता है। न्यूनतम तापमान करीब 17 डिग्री सेल्सियस रहने का अनुमान है। सुबह-शाम ठंड का असर बढ़ेगा।मानसून के बाद 29 और 30 अक्टूबर को हुई बूंदाबांदी के बाद बारिश के रिकॉर्ड के थोड़ा सुधार हुआ है लेकिन सामान्य से अभी भी काफी कम है। मौसम विभाग के अनुसार, 1 से 4 नवंबर के बीच आगरा में सामान्य तौर पर 18.9 मिमी बारिश होनी चाहिए थी, लेकिन इस अवधि में केवल 8.9 मिमी बारिश दर्ज की गई। इस तरह अक्टूबर में अब तक सामान्य से करीब 53 प्रतिशत कम बारिश हुई है। आगरा में 1 जून से 30 सितंबर तक चले मानसून सीजन में कुल 527.2 मिमी बारिश दर्ज की गई। इस अवधि में सामान्य बारिश का आंकड़ा 530.3 मिमी था। यानी पूरे मानसून सीजन में सामान्य से केवल 3.1 मिमी या करीब 1 प्रतिशत कम बारिश हुई।हालांकि, मानसून के दौरान बारिश का वितरण एक जैसा नहीं रहा। कुछ दिनों में तेज बारिश हुई, जबकि कई दिनों तक बारिश कम रही। इसी वजह से पूरे सीजन में बारिश का आंकड़ा सामान्य के करीब रहा, लेकिन अक्टूबर में बारिश की कमी बनी हुई है।गोरखपुर में बदलते मौसम ने बिगाड़ी सेहतहिमाचल के ऊंचे पहाड़ों पर ठंड, मैदानी इलाकों में गर्मीसर्दी की शुरुआत के साथ ही राजस्थान की हवा जहरीली

बिहार के ग्रामीण इलाकों में ठंड बढ़ने लगी है. बिहार के गया, पटना, भोजपुर, गोपालगंज, जहानाबाद, रोहतास, वैशाली, बक्सर, समस्तीपुर, भागलपुर, खगड़िया, मुंगेर में बारिश हो सकती है. पटना में अधिकतम तापमान 32 डिग्री सेल्सियस और न्यूनतम तापमान 28 डिग्री सेल्सियस रहेगा.
राजस्थान में कैसा है मौसम-
राजस्थान में जयपुर, झुंझुनू, सीकर, सवाई माधोपुर, चुरू, अजमेर, टोंक, बीकानेर, बूंदी, चित्तौड़गढ़, धौलपुर और भरतपुर में भारी बारिश हो सकती है. जयपुर में अधिकतम तापमान 32 डिग्री सेल्सियस और न्यूनतम तापमान 18 डिग्री सेल्सियस रहेगा.
पश्चिम बंगाल का मौसम-
बंगाल की खाड़ी के ऊपर बने गंभीर चक्रवाती तूफान मुरासु का असर दिखाई दे रहा है. कई इलाकों में बारिश हो रही है. पश्चिम बंगाल के बीरभूम, हावड़ा, कोलकाता, दुर्गापुर, पुरुलिया, मुर्शिदाबाद, बीरभूम और नादिया में मूसलाधार बारिश और आंधी की चेतावनी है. कोलकाता में अधिकतम तापमान 31 डिग्री सेल्सियस और न्यूनतम तापमान 22 डिग्री सेल्सियस रहेगा.

CAIRO - 5 November 2026: The country is experiencing a notable shift in weather conditions as the recent heatwave subsides and cooler air masses begin to move across the nation.

Current Weather Shifts
Dr. Mohamed Ali Fahim, head of the Climate Change Information Center at the Agricultural Research Center, stated that the current weather shifts mark a transition from the hot conditions seen recently to a more moderate climate, characterized by milder days and cooler nights.

AS heat-related deaths rise, The World Academy of Sciences brings together 60 climate, medical, and social scientists to study how extreme heat harms health
Sixty scientists from 40 countries are meeting in Trieste, Italy this week for the Heat Health Science workshop to set a global research agenda for heat-health science. This emerging field brings together experts in physiology, climate science, medicine, and public health to generate the evidence needed to turn research into action that protects people from extreme heat. The Heat Health Science workshop will take place from 3 to 6 November and is the first major activity of The World Academy of Sciences (TWAS) Transformative Heat-Health Science initiative (THHS).
Extreme heat is a growing threat to human health worldwide, and conventional public health measures are increasingly falling short. Closing the gap between climate experts and health experts will require new knowledge that no single discipline can produce. This workshop aims to bring together disciplines that have historically worked in silos, sparking conversations across scientific fields and identifying interdisciplinary opportunities that can build heat-health science into a research field of its own.
During the four-day workshop, participants will tackle heat-health challenges with insights from fields ranging from biology and physics to ecophysiology, pinpointing the most pressing knowledge gaps and aligning priorities for future research. The discussions will be guided by a committee of nine leading international experts in heat-health science and related fields.
All participants were selected for their expertise, scientific record, leadership, and interdisciplinary experience, with an emphasis on broad geographic representation. Many participants work in the regions where extreme heat hits hardest, bringing on-the-ground knowledge and research expertise from the regions most exposed to extreme heat and on which solutions can work in practice. Their leadership helps ensure that the new field is shaped by the communities that stand to benefit most.
“TWAS was created to bring scientists together across borders. By convening experts from many disciplines and from some of the countries most affected by extreme heat, we hope to help shape a stronger and more coordinated research agenda and accelerate the generation of evidence needed to address one of the most pressing health challenges of our time,” said Marcelo Knobel, TWAS executive director.

Shabakad dambiileyaal ah oo ku shaqaysan jiray 20 sano "Aabbayaal bug ah" iyo "carruur" oo la soo qarxiyey
Iyagoo shaqaaleysiiyay dhowr muwaadin oo reer Thailand ah oo ugu kacaya lacag u dhaxaysa dhowr kun ilaa tobanaan kun oo baht ah, lamaanayaasha Shiinaha ayaa si fudud ugu heli kara dhalashada Thailand carruurtooda iyada oo loo marayo habka xaqiijinta abtirsiinta oo loo yaqaan 'pho thip' iyo 'ban phi'.
Xadgudub ballaaran oo loo sameeyey qaab khiyaano ah ayaa bilaabmay bishii Abriil, markii booliisku ay xireen Chen Yinlai, oo ah muwaadin Shiinees ah oo ku nool Thailand.
Wuxuu lacag u waday kooxaha burcadda caalamiga ah.
Baaritaanku wuxuu shaaca ka qaaday in lacagta loo diray Bao Jiao Chen, oo la rumeysan yahay inay tahay xaaska Chen, iyada oo loo marayo akoonno kala duwan oo wakiillo ah. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, waxaa la tuhunsanaa in saddexda carruurta ah ee waalidiinta Shiinaha la siiyay dhalashada sharci darrada ah, maadaama la ogaaday inay haystaan dhalasho Thai ah.
Baaritaan dheeraad ah ayaa lagu ogaaday in muwaadin Thai ah oo lagu magacaabo Montri (magaca dambe lama shaacin) uu u diiwaangashan yahay aabaha saddexda carruur ah.
Baaritaanku wuxuu shaaca ka qaaday in shaqaale ka tirsan isbitaal gaar loo leeyahay oo ku yaal Bangkok uu waalidiinta Shiinaha siiyay xirmo uur iyo dhalmo ah oo ku kacaysa qiyaastii boqol kun oo baht.
Shaqaalaha ayaa markaa u diyaariyay nin Thai ah inuu noqdo aabaha carruurta, si carruurtu ay u helaan dhalashada Thailand iyadoo lagu saleynayo abtirsiintooda.
Sarkaal diiwaangelin ah oo ka tirsan Xafiiska Degmada Thonburi ee Bangkok ayaa sidoo kale looga shakisan yahay inuu ku lug lahaa khiyaanadan.
Markii hore, hay'adaha dowladda ee ay khuseyso ayaa ogaaday in ugu yaraan 62 dhalasho laga yaabo in lagu diiwaangeliyay qaabkan.
Hase yeeshee, marka loo eego xogta ugu dambeysay, tiradan ayaa gaartay 1,400. Arrintaas ka dib, waxaa dalka Thailand laga fuliyay hawlgal wadajir ah oo baaxad weyn leh.
Baaritaanka wajigiisii saddexaad ayaa hadda socda, waxaana ilaa iyo hadda la xiray ugu yaraan 67 qof oo lagu eedeeyay arrintan.
Boqolaal carruur ah oo loo yaqaano 'Carruurta Ruuxiga'
Dr. Ratwich Jitsujaritwong, oo ah agaasimaha Xarunta Isku dubaridka ee La dagaallanka Khatarta Amniga ee Waaxda Maamulka Gobolka (DOPA NICE), ayaa u sheegay BBC Thai in habka ugu badan ee loo isticmaalo khiyaanadan ay tahay in la abuuro 'aabbe been abuur ah' iyadoo la siinayo lacag muwaadin Thai ah.
Nidaamkan, hooyooyinka ajnabiga ah waxay u yimaadaan Thailand daaweyn caafimaad inta lagu jiro xilliga uurka iyo dhalmada, ka dibna waxay lacag siiyaan nin Thai ah si uu si rasmi ah ugu aqoonsado inay yihiin aabaha ilmaha.
Iyada oo ku saleysan qaabkan ayaa isbitaalku wuxuu soo saari karaa shahaadada dhalashada (Tor. 1/1). Shahaadadani waxay noqotaa shahaadada dhalashada ilmaha wuxuuna heli karaa dhalashada Thailand iyadoo lagu saleynayo abtirsiinta.
Intii lagu jiray hawlgalladii ugu dambeeyay, Xarunta Isku dubaridka ee La dagaallanka Khatarta Amniga ee Diiwaangelinta ayaa ogaatay in shabakad abaabulan ay ka shaqeyneyso khiyaanadan.
Inta ay khiyaanadan socoto, qolooyin dilaaliin ah ayaa raadiya oo keena rag Thai ah oo loo soo bandhigayo sidii Aabeyaal ilmaha korsaday.
Shaqaalaha waaxda diiwaanka caafimaadka ee isbitaalka iyo saraakiisha diiwaangelinta ayaa sidoo kale ku lug leh ka caawinta hawshan.
Si kastaba ha ahaatee, sida laga soo xigtay Xarunta, isla habkan lama qaato kiis kasta mana jiro had iyo jeer ku lug lahaanshaha dhexdhexaadiyeyaasha.
Sida laga soo xigtay agaasimaha Xarunta Isku-dubaridka ee La dagaallanka Hanjabaadaha Amniga ee Diiwaangelinta, qiyaastii 90 boqolkiiba kiisaskan khiyaanada shahaadada dhalashada ayaa ka dhaca Bangkok. Tani waxay sabab u tahay tiro badan oo isbitaallo gaar loo leeyahay ah oo ku yaal Bangkok. Isbitaalladani waxay gacanta ku diyaariyaan shahaadooyinka dhalashada, halka isbitaallada dawladdu ay isticmaalaan nidaam elektaroonig ah. Dembiilayaashu waxay ka faa'iidaystaan cilladdan.
BBC Thai waxay ogaatay in Oktoobar 27, wejigii saddexaad ee hawlgalka wadajirka ah ee ka dhanka ah khiyaanada 'Pho Thip' lagu qabtay muwaadin Shiinees ah oo helay dhalashada Thailand iyada oo loo marayo shabakadda oo uu jiray 27 sano. Wuxuu ku noolaa Thailand noloshiisa oo dhan, wuxuu wax ku bartay machad waxbarasho oo halkaas ku yaal wuxuuna injineernimo ugu shaqeeyay shirkad gaar loo leeyahay.
Marka laga soo tago middan, kiis mataano ah oo 23 jir ah oo ka soo jeeda qoys Shiinees ah ayaa sidoo kale soo ifbaxay. Mid ka mid ah waa barnaamij sameeye, halka kan kalena uu ka baranayo daawada jaamacad caan ah oo ku taal Thailand.
Da'da carruurta Shiinaha ah ee dhalashada lagu siiyay magaca aabbayaashood oo ah dad Thai ah, ayaa muujinaysa in dhaqankani uu socday muddo ka badan 20 sano. Warbaahinta dalka Thailand ayaa carruurtaas ugu yeerta 'carruurta ruuxiga' ama 'carruurta Shiinaha'.
Taliyaha xafiiska socdaalka Jeneraal Nophasin Poolsawat, ayaa sheegay in ay jiraan 1,483 kiis oo looga shakisan yahay 'ka ganacsiga jirka carruurta'.
Booliisku waxay isticmaalayaan baaritaannada DNA-da si ay u caddeeyaan aabbanimada iyo dacwad ku soo oogidda dambiilayaasha. Ilaa hadda, 67 eedaysane ayaa la xiray ayadoo la soo saaray74 amar oo xarig ah. Waxaa ka mid ah 'hooyooyin' Shiinees ah, 'aabbayaal been abuur ah' oo Thai ah, shaqaalaha isbitaalka iyo mas'uuliyiinta dowladda. Kuwaas, 47 kiis ayaa ku lug leh 'ka ganacsiga jirka carruurta'.
Waxaa jira hab kale oo lagu siinayo dhalashada Thailand carruurta ay dhaleen waalidiinta Shiinaha, oo loo yaqaan 'Dhaqdhaqaaqa Guriga Ruuxa'. Carruurta hela dhalashada habkan waxaa sidoo kale loo yaqaan 'carruur ruuxi ah'.
Dr. Ratwich, oo ah agaasimaha Xarunta Isku dubaridka ee La dagaallanka Hanjabaadaha Amniga ayaa sharraxay in habkani uu ka duwan yahay habka 'aabaha been abuurka ah'. Ku dhawaad dhammaan macluumaadka waa 'laga soo qaatay'.
Saraakiisha diiwaangelinta maxalliga ah waxay diiwaan geliyaan faahfaahin been abuur ah, oo ay ku jiraan faahfaahinta dhalashada iyo macluumaadka waalidka, nidaamyada dowladda. Khiyaanadan ayaa la kashifay markii Xaruntu ogaatay in nin u dhashay Thailand uu u diiwaan gashan yahay aabbe ilmo ah isagoon ogayn. Intaa kaliya ma aha, magaca isbitaal aan lahayn xarumo umuliso ayaa sidoo kale si aan kala sooc lahayn loo qoray. Dabadeed waxaa magaca ilmaha u wareejiyay guri jinn 'ghost house'.
Kuwani waa guryo leh lambar guri oo keliya, laakiin aan lahayn cinwaan dhab ah. Sidan, faahfaahinta diiwaangelinta ayaa loo beddelay si ay u muujiso da'da dhabta ah ee ilmaha.
Dr. Ratwich ayaa u sheegay BBC Thai, "Habraacan weligii ma dhammaan doono, sababtoo ah da'da dhabta ah ee ilmuhu waa toddobo sano, balse hadda uun buu helay shahaadada dhalashada. Si da'da ilmaha wax looga beddelo, waa in diiwaangelinta lagu xiraa guri ku yaalla aaggaas. Sidaa darteed, hawshan waxaa lagu qaban karaa oo keliya awoodda maamul ee xafiiska degmada, waana inuu halkaas ka jiraa guri. Hawshan waxaa ku lug leh mukhallasiin. Waxay adeegsadaan diiwaangelinta guri gaar ah, iyagoo iska kaashanaya mas'uuliyiinta xafiiska degmada. Waxaan ogaanay in mukhallasiinta ku lugta leh kiisaskan 'guryaha aan jirin' (ghost houses) horey dhowr jeer loo xiray, ayna xiriir la leeyihiin mukhallasiin caalami ah. Tani waxay ka dhigan tahay inay adeegsadaan shabakadooda si ay macaamiil uga soo helaan dalalkooda hooyo. Hay'addeennu waxay hadda kala shaqaynaysaa Qaybta La dagaallanka Dambiyada sidii loo ballaarin lahaa baaxadda baaritaankan."
Maxaabiis ayaa waxaa laga soo xiray gobollada Nakhon Ratchasima iyo Kanchanaburi bishii Abriil iyo Maajo 2016, fadeexaddii loogu magac daray 'dhalashada jinniyada'. Tan iyo markaas, waaxda maamulka gobolku waxay joojisay in ka badan 100 shahaadooyin dhalasho oo carruurtan ah.
Waxaa sidoo kale tallaabo laga qaadayaa qof walba laga bilaabo karraaniga degmada ilaa saraakiisha diiwaangelinta maxalliga ah iyo mukhallasiinta. Qaar badan oo ka mid ah mukhallasiinta waa mas'uuliyiin hore oo dowladeed sidaas darteedna si fiican u yaqaan nidaamka diiwaangelinta madaniga ah ee Thailand.
Dr. Ratwich wuxuu sheegay in Thailand ay leedahay qodob u oggolaanaya ajaanibta inay si sharci ah u helaan dhalashada Thailand iyadoo lagu saleynayo shuruudo kala duwan. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, habkani wuxuu qaadan karaa waqti. Maadaama dambiilayaashu ay u arkaan habkan sharciga ah mid dheer, waxay adeegsadaan jid gaaban oo sharci darro ah sida 'guryaha jinniyada' si ay si dhakhso ah oo qiimo jaban ugu helaan dhalashada.
Halka ay timid kalmadda 'Aabbaha Ruuxiga'
Taariikhdu markay ahayd 27-kii Oktoobar, intii lagu guda jiray wajiga saddexaad ee hawlgalka lagula dagaallamayo khiyaanada loo yaqaan 'pho thip' (aabbe been-abuur ah), nin 56 jir ah oo darawal mooto taxi ah, magaciisuna yahay Somkiat (magaciisa dambe lama shaacin), kuna nool aagga On Nut ee magaalada Bangkok, ayaa booliiska u sheegay inuusan aqoon haweeney u dhalatay dalka Shiinaha oo 46 jir ah, magaceeduna yahay Yanfang (magaceeda dambe lama shaacin).
Haweeneydan ayaa dalka Thailand ku noolayd tan iyo sannadkii 2007-dii. Somkiat ayaa sheegay in darawal kale oo mooto-taxi ah uu ku qanciyay inuu iska diiwaangeliyo guur uu la yeelanayo haweeneyda Shiinaha ah, isagoo ballanqaaday inuu siin doono 5,000 oo Baht (lacagta Thailand) haddii uu sidaas sameeyo.
Dhacdadan ayaa dhacday sannadkii 2018-kii. Somkiat wuxuu sheegay in qof uu yimid si uu haweeneyda u soo qaado, isla markaana diyaariyay dhammaan dukumeentiyada guurka. Intaas ka dib, isaga iyo Yanfang waxay guurkooda ka diiwaangeliyeen Xafiiska Degmada Lak Si sannadkii 2018-kii. Kadib, sannadkii 2021-kii, labadooduba waxay furiinkooda ka diiwaangeliyeen Xafiiska Degmada Huai Khwang. Arrintaas darteed, haweeneydu waxay heshay 4,000 oo Baht oo dheeraad ah oo magdhow ahaan loogu siiyay.
Somkiat ayaa yiri, "Markii aan qolka galnayba, saraakiishu waxay na siiyeen dukumeentiyadii. Dukumeentiyadaas horay ayaa loo sii hubiyay, waxaana loo diyaariyay inaan saxiixno. Waan saxiixnay, kadibna qof walba wuxuu aaday dhinaciisa." Labada qof waxay is arkeen laba jeer oo keliya.
Somkiat wuxuu booliiska u xaqiijiyay inuusan weligiis saxiixin wax dukumeenti ah oo qiraya inuu aabbe u yahay ilmo. Sidoo kale, ma uusan ogeyn in haweeneydu ay uur lahayd intii uu guurku socday. Markii la xiray isagoo lagu eedeeyay khiyaano la xiriirta diiwaangelinta dadweynaha, ayuu ogaaday in magaciisa lagu qoray aabbe ahaan shahaadada dhalashada ee wiil toddobo jir ah. Ilmahaasi waa wiilka Yanfang iyo ninkeeda hadda, Zhang (magaciisa dambe lama shaacin). Zhang waa 49 jir, waana muwaadin u dhashay dalka Shiinaha.
Iyadoo booliisku ay su'aalo weydiinayeen Somkiat, Zhang ayaa la ag fadhiisiyey isagoo waji xiran.
Wuxuu beeniyay inuu wax lug ah ku lahaa qorista ama soo xulista dadka ku lug yeeshay khiyaanadan.
Wuxuu sheegay in xaaskiisu ay iyadu wax walba samaysay. Xaaskiisu waxay ka dhooftay dalka Thailand taariikhdu markay ahayd 30-kii Sebtembar, mana aysan soo laaban ilaa hadda. Booliisku waxay soo saareen amar lagu soo xirayo xaaska Zhang, oo lagu magacaabo Yanfang.
Shahaadada dhalashada ee wiilka labaad ee lamaanaha Shiinaha ah, kaas oo saddex jir ah, ayaa sidoo kale ku xusaysa in aabuhu yahay nin u dhashay Thailand oo 54 jir ah, kaas oo lagu magacaabo Yingbao (magaciisa dambe lama shaacin).
Yingbao wuxuu ku doodayaa inuu cunugga u aqbalay inuu isagu dhalay, maadaama uu xiriir hore la lahaa Yanfang, sidaas darteedna uu u maleeyay in cunuggu yahay kiisa. Hase yeeshee, natiijooyinka baaritaanka hidde sidayaasha (DNA) ee ay sameeyeen booliisku ayaa hadda daaha ka qaaday in aabaha dhabta ah ee cunugga uu yahay Zhang.
Yingbao ayaa booliiska u sheegay "Arrintan ka dib, waxaan codsan doonaa in la joojiyo baaritaanka aabanimada, sababtoo ah qalad baan sameeyay."
Saddexda nin ayaa lagu xiray guri gaar ah oo ku yaalla degmada Muang, ee gobolka Samut Prakan. Gurigaas waa goobta ay degan yihiin Yanfang iyo qoyska Zhang. Gurigaas dhexdiisa waxaa sidoo kale ku yaalla xafiisyada laba shirkadood oo gaar loo leeyahay, raggaasna waxay labaduba ka shaqeeyaan shirkadahaas iyagoo ah agaasimayaal. Hawsha ugu weyn ee shirkadahani qabtaan waa soo dejinta iyo dhoofinta badeecadaha, iyo sidoo kale ganacsiga jumladaha iyo tafaariiqda ee alaabta maalinlaha ah.
Taariikhda iyo xaaladda Yingbao ayaa iyaduna ah mid aan caadi ahayn. Waxaa lagu hayaa baaritaan la xiriira tuhun ah inuu u shaqeynayay sidii qof magaciisa lagu qariyo hantida dadka ajnabiga ah (waxa loo yaqaan 'benami'). Wuxuu xubin ka yahay guddiga maamulka ee 10 shirkadood oo kala duwan oo ka hawlgala Thailand. Ku dhawaad dhammaan shirkadahani waxay leeyihiin magacyo sharci oo ku qoran luqadda Shiinaha.
Maaha markii ugu horreysay ee shirkad Shiinees ah lagu soo bandhigo inay tahay benami. Tusaale ahaan, bishii Luulyo ee la soo dhaafay, booliisku waxay xireen Prachuab Sirikhet. Waxaa lagu eedeeyay inuu u shaqeynayay shirkadda tareenka Shiinaha ee No. 10 (Thailand) Company Limited. Shirkaddu waxay ka mid ahayd shirkadaha wadajirka ah ee mas'uulka ka ahaa dhismaha cusub ee Xafiiska Hantidhawrka Guud (OAG). Dhismaha ayaa ku burburay dhulgariirkii Maarso 2015 ee ka dhacay Myanmar. Waa dhismaha kaliya ee ku burburay dhulgariirkaas. Masiibadu waxay dishay 93 qof, saddex way maqan yihiin, siddeed kalena way dhaawacmeen.
Warbixinta guddiga baaritaanka ayaa lagu sheegay in dhismaha uu dumay sababo la xiriira cillado dhowr ah oo ku saabsan naqshadeyntiisa, hababka dhismaha, agabka tayadiisu hooseyso, iyo dhismaha sharci darrada ah.
Markii baaritaanka fadeexadda aabbanimada ee ka bilaabatay kiiska Chen Yinlai uu sii ballaartay, mas'uuliyiintu waxay xireen Prachuap iyagoo lagu eedeeyay inuu u dhaqmayo sidii "qof aan la garanayn." Si kastaba ha ahaatee, faahfaahinta qoyska Shiinaha ee uu sheegtay inuu aabbo u yahay lama shaacin. Prachuap wuxuu sheeganayaa inuu yahay aabaha ilmaha oo uu yaqaan haweeneyda Shiinaha ee uu guursaday. Laakiin baaritaannada DNA-da ayaa muujiyay in uusan ahayn aabaha ilmaha uu sheegtay.
Dr. Ratwich wuxuu yiri "Inta badan muwaadiniinta Thailand ee u shaqeeya sida benami, qiyaastii 80 boqolkiiba horeyba way isu yaqaaneen ilaa xad. Ma aha dad dibadda ka yimid. Haddii uu jiro qof dibadda ka yimid, badanaa waxaa loo qoraa dhex dhexaadiyayaal. Tusaale ahaan, ganacsatada daroogada ama darawallada taksiga mootooyinka."
Wuxuu raaciyay "Waxay la macno tahay in dadka noocaas ah aysan si cad u fikirin, sida kuwa fura akoonnada been abuurka ah."
Isbitaallada gaarka loo leeyahay ma ku lug leeyihiin?
Wasiir ku xigeenka Arrimaha Gudaha Worasit Liengprasit ayaa shir jaraa'id ku sheegay Oktoobar 27 in khiyaanada 'pho thip' (aabaha been abuurka ah) ay ka soo bilaabatay 11 isbitaal oo ku yaal Bangkok. Habka ugu weyn ee khiyaanada waxaa ka mid ah in dumarka uurka leh ee Shiinaha la keeno Thailand iyo in ragga Thai ay si been abuur ah u sheegtaan aabanimadooda inay yihiin aabbayaasha carruurtaas.
Ujeeddada ka dambeysa arrintan ayaa ah in la helo faa'iidooyin kala duwan mustaqbalka, oo ay ku jiraan dhalashada, degenaanshaha, lahaanshaha hantida iyo fursadaha ganacsiga. "Kiisas badan oo noocaas ah ayaa waxaa ku lug leh dad aan la garanayn, sababtoo ah ujeeddooyinka eedaysanayaasha ka dambeeya falalkan ayaa ah kuwo aad u xun" ayuu yiri.
Si kastaba ha ahaatee, ilaa hadda ma jiro isbitaal gaar loo leeyahay oo lagu soo oogay dacwad ku saabsan ku lug lahaanshaha khiyaanadan ka faa'iidaysiga carruurta. Kaliya shaqaalaha musuqmaasuqa ku shaqaysta ee waaxda diiwaannada caafimaadka ee isbitaallada ayaa la maxkamadeeyay.
Iyada oo hooyooyinka Shiinaha ay bixinayaan malaayiin baht (qiyaastii boqol kun baht) oo loogu talagalay uurka iyo dhalmada ee isbitaalladan, BBC Thai ayaa su'aal ka keentay inay suurtogal tahay in isbitaallada gaarka loo leeyahay aysan ku lug lahayn khiyaanada gabi ahaanba.
Worasit ayaa shir jaraa'id ka sheegay in isbitaal aan la helin lagu arkay inuu ku lug leeyahay. Dhab ahaantii, isbitaallo badan ayaa maalgashaday balaayiin baht ah.
"Waxaan aaminsanahay haddii ay rabaan inay ka faa'iidaystaan kiisaska noocaas ah, waxay u muuqataa inay macquul tahay inay sidaas sameeyaan. Baaritaanka ilaa hadda wuxuu muujiyay ku lug lahaanshaha shaqsiyaad ka mid ah isbitaalka. Tani waa falkooda shaqsiyeed" ayuu yiri.
Piarat Jongthep oo ah Xildhibaan ka tirsan Xisbiga Dadka (People's Party), ayaa qaba aragti ka duwan. Wuxuu si dhow ula socdaa kiiska fadeexadda 'pho thip' (aabbe been abuur ah). Sidoo kale, waa guddoomiye ku xigeenka koowaad ee Guddiga Sharciga, Caddaaladda, iyo Xuquuqul Insaanka ee Golaha Wakiillada.
Wuxuu yiri "Isbitaalkuna waa inuu qaataa mas'uuliyaddiisa. Waayo, isbitaalku wuxuu ogyahay in dukumeentiyada sida foomka TR. 1/1 ay muhiim yihiin, isla markaana shahaadada dhalashada lagu samayn karo iyadoo lagu salaynayo dukumeentigaas. Haddii shahaadadan ay ku jiraan macluumaad khaldan, ama haddii si ula kac ah loo bixiyay faahfaahin aan sax ahayn, waxay taasi dhaawici kartaa kalsoonida lagu qabo isbitaalka. Sidaa darteed, aad bay u adag tahay in isbitaalku iska fogeeyo mas'uuliyaddiisa. Hase yeeshee, dowladduna sidoo kale kama bixi karto mas'uuliyaddeeda; gaar ahaan Wasaaradda Caafimaadka, oo iyadu mas'uul ka ah kormeeridda iyo hubinta heerarka iyo tayada isbitaallada."
Piarat wuxuu sheegay inaysan suurtagal ahayn in qof uu ku dhalo isbitaal gaar loo leeyahay isagoon wadan dukumeentiyo sax ah. Ugu yaraan, haweeneydu waa inay heshaa daryeel caafimaad inta ay uurka leedahay. Xaaladdan oo kale, shaqaalaha isbitaalka waxaa laga filayay inay shaki ka qabaan sababta aabbaha u dhashay Shiinaha, kaas oo xaaskiisa ku daryeelayay isbitaalka intii ay uurka lahayd, aan loogu diiwaangelin aabbe ahaan shahaadada dhalashada ilmaha (foomka Tor. 1/1). Waayo, dukumeentigan laftiisa ayaa loo adeegsadaa codsiga lagu qaadanayo shahaadada dhalashada.
Xildhibaanka mucaaradka ah ayaa yiri, "Waxaa laga yaabaa in mas'uuliyiintu ay dayac sameeyeen, ama waxaa dhici karta inay si ula kac ah uga qayb qaateen khiyaanadan iyagoo qaadanaya laaluush. Sidaa darteed, waa in la sameeyaa baaritaan dheeraad ah si loo ogaado in isbitaalkuna uu ku lug lahaa arrintan iyo in kale."
Arkhom Praditsuwan, oo ah Agaasime ku xigeenka Guud ee Waaxda Taageerada Adeegyada Caafimaadka (DHSS), ayaa isna warbixin la mid ah u gudbiyay Wasiir ku xigeenka Wasaaradda Arrimaha Gudaha. Wuxuu sheegay in khaladaadka ama falalka aan sharciga waafaqsanayn ay ka dhaceen oo kaliya heer shakhsi ah.
Agaasime ku xigeenka Guud ee Waaxda Taageerada Adeegyada Caafimaadka ayaa yiri, "Waxaan baaritaan ku sameynay maamulayaasha isbitaalka, maamulayaasha xarumaha caafimaadka ee mas'uulka ka ah dhammaan adeegyada la siiyo bukaannada, iyo madaxda qaybaha dhalmada. Waxaa la ogaaday in khaladaadku ay ka dhaceen heer shakhsi ah." Arkom ayaa intaa ku daray in ka dib markii la soo sheegay dhacdada diiwaangelinta dhalashada ee ku saabsan khiyaanada 'pho thip' (aabbo been abuurka ah), Wasaaradda Caafimaadku waxay qaadday tallaabooyin lagu hubinayo in qof kale uusan diiwaangelin karin dhalashada isagoo matalaya isbitaallada. Hadda ninka iyo xaaskiisuba waa inay si shaqsi ah ugu tagaan sarkaalka diiwaangelinta si ay u diiwaangeliyaan dhalashada.
Waaxda Kaalmada Adeegyada Caafimaadka ayaa qabatay in ka badan 400 oo diiwaan caafimaad oo la xiriira 11 isbitaal oo gaar loo leeyahay halkaas oo laga soo sheegay 'cillad ka jirta diiwaangelinta carruurta' oo loo wareejiyay baarayaasha si ay tallaabo sharci ah uga qaadaan tan iyo bishii Luulyo.
Piarat wuxuu sheegay in hababkani aysan suurtogal ahayn haddii aan muwaadiniinta Thai aysan diyaar u ahayn inay u dhaqmaan sidii mukhallasiin, iyagoo la kaashanaya mas'uuliyiinta musuqmaasuqa ah ee ka shaqeeya laaluushka.
"Waxaan u maleynayaa waxa aan aragno waa kaliya in yar oo ka mid ah dhibaatadan" ayuu yiri. Wuxuu intaas ku daray in shabakaddan ay khatar amni ku tahay Thailand sababtoo ah waxay la xiriiraan khiyaanooyinka caalamiga ah ee firfircoon iyo mareegaha khamaarka internetka. Dadkani waxay rabaan inay abuuraan nidaam joogto ah oo lagu wareejiyo hantida iyo lacagta Thailand, taasoo u beddeleysa lacag sharci ah. Tani way ka fududahay in laga sameeyo Thailand marka loo eego Shiinaha, halkaas oo sharciyadu ay adag yihiin.
Intaa waxaa dheer, maadaama carruurta ku dhalata habkan la siiyo dhalashada Thai laga bilaabo dhalashada, kooxaha maalgashiga shisheeye, gaar ahaan kooxaha Shiinaha, waxay ku xadgudbi karaan qorshaha. Horey, waxay u isticmaali jireen magacyada muwaadiniinta Thai inay shirkado ka furaan Thailand oo ay hantidooda ku hayaan magacyadooda. Hadda, iyagoo bixinaya macluumaad been abuur ah, waxay si dhakhso ah u siin karaan carruurtooda dhalashada Thailand. Kadib waxay u isticmaali karaan carruurtan inay hanti caadi ah iyo hanti ma-guurto ah ku haystaan magacyadooda, sida muwaadiniinta Thai.
Laakiin walaaca ugu weyn ee Piarat ayaa ah in Thailand ay si aan ula kac ahayn u noqon karto dhibane faragelin shisheeye oo ku aaddan nidaamkeeda siyaasadeed iyo dowladeed, maadaama "carruurta sidan ku hela dhalashada" loo magacaabi karo militariga, booliiska iyo jagooyinka kale ee muhiimka ah. Jagooyinkan waxay u baahan yihiin inay noqdaan muwaadiniin Thai ah dhalasho ahaan iyo inay yeeshaan aabbe Thai ah.
Piarat wuxuu yiri, "Cunugga noocaas ah wuxuu xaq u leeyahay inuu u tartamo doorashada isagoo ah xildhibaan baarlamaan iyo in loo magacaabo musharrax u taagan jagada Ra'iisul Wasaaraha, sababtoo ah xuquuqdan waxaa la bixiyaa laga bilaabo dhalashada." Wuxuu raaciyay, "Ka fikir, sida ay u xun tahay arrintan!"
Dr. Ratwich, oo ah agaasimaha Xarunta Isku dubaridka ee Ka hortagga Hanjabaadaha Diiwaangelinta Madaniga ah ee Qaranka ee Waaxda Maamulka Gobolka, ayaa u sheegay BBC Thai in dowladda iyo Wasaaradda Arrimaha Gudaha, gaar ahaan Waaxda Maamulka Gobolka, ay si fiican uga warqabaan xaqiiqda ah in si khiyaano ah loo helo dhalashada Thailand iyada oo loo marayo qorshayaasha 'aabaha ruuxiga' iyo 'guriga jinniga' ay tahay khatar weyn oo ku wajahan amniga qaranka.
Tani sababteedu waa nooca dambiyadan iyo saameynta ay ku leeyihiin dalka oo si weyn isu beddelay marka la barbar dhigo hababka dhaqanka jinsiyadda ee khiyaanada ah ee loo isticmaali jiray waagii hore.
Wuxuu sheegay in waagii hore, dhibaatooyinka khiyaanada diiwaangelinta madaniga ah badanaa lagu arki jiray kooxaha qabiillada, dadka laga tirada badan yahay ama dadka ka soo cararaya saboolnimada dalalka deriska ah oo u imanaya Thailand si ay u raadsadaan fursado waxbarasho ama shaqo. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, labadii ilaa saddexdii sano ee la soo dhaafay, dadka isku dayaya inay helaan dhalashada Thailand waxaa badanaa lala xiriiriyay macaamil ganacsi oo laga shakiyo, khiyaanooyin iyo kooxo ku lug leh lacago been abuur ah oo caalami ah.
Khiyaanada diiwaangelinta noocan oo kale ah waxay u oggolaanaysaa xitaa dadka wajahaya dacwado dambiyeed oo halis ah oo dibadda ah inay isticmaalaan dhalashada Thailand si ay uga baxsadaan Interpol ama ay qariyaan aqoonsigooda. Waxay abuuraan aqoonsiyo cusub si ay u qariyaan hawlahooda sharci darrada ah. Iyagoo si sharci darro ah u helaya dhalashada, ajaanibtu waxay sidoo kale ka qaadi karaan muwaadiniinta Thailand kheyraad, faa'iidooyin, barnaamijyo samafal, iyo fursado.
Intaa waxaa dheer, shabakadaha noocan oo kale ah waxay wiiqayaan kalsoonida iyo xasilloonida nidaamka diiwaangelinta madaniga ah. Tani waa dhibaato aad u walaac badan. Sababtan awgeed, xarun isku dubarid, oo ah DOPA NICE, ayaa la aasaasay wax ka yar hal sano ka hor si wax looga qabto khataraha diiwaangelinta madaniga ah.
Dr. Ratwich ayaa u sheegay BBC Thai, "Hadda DOPA NICE waxay leedahay laba hawlood oo waaweyn: ka hortagga khiyaanada iyo baabi'inteeda gebi ahaanba."
Halkan, 'ka hortagga' macnaheedu waa in khiyaanada diiwaangelinta ay ka dhigto mid adag ama ku dhawaad aan macquul ahayn iyada oo loo marayo tallaabooyin adag oo ay hirgelisay waaxda maamulka gobolka. Hadda, madaxa waaxda diiwaangelinta ee heerka C8 oo keliya ayaa leh awoodda uu ku ansixiyo shahaadooyinka dhalashada. Hore, hay'addan ayaa sidoo kale la socotay mas'uuliyiinta heerka C5-C6. Isbeddelkan waxaa la sameeyay si loo sameeyo habka baaritaanka mid aad u daran. Sidoo kale way adag tahay in la musuqmaasuqo mas'uul heer sare ah iyadoo la siinayo lacag.
Intaa waxaa dheer, waaxda maamulka gobolka ayaa sidoo kale xoojisay tallaabooyinka xaqiijinta aqoonsiga. Hadda, saraakiisha diiwaangelinta waa inay sameeyaan baaritaanno faahfaahsan oo ku saabsan codsadayaasha u imanaya diiwaangelinta dhalashada. Haddii ay jirto shaki ama hubanti la'aan, saraakiishu waxay awood u leeyihiin inay dalbadaan baaritaan DNA ah si loo xaqiijiyo xiriirka dhabta ah ee dhiigga ka hor inta aysan bixin shahaadada dhalashada.
Maxaa ku dhacaya 'Carruurta Ruuxiga' marka la qabto?
Dr. Ratwich ayaa sharraxay tallaabooyinka xiga ee la qaadi doono ee la xiriira diiwaangelinta carruurtan. Shahaadooyinkooda dhalasho ee asalka ah, kuwaas oo lagu bixiyay xog been abuur ah, ayaa isla markiiba la baabi'in doonaa, lagana saari doonaa nidaamka diiwaangelinta. Tani waxay sidoo kale horseedi doontaa in la baabi'iyo dhalashada Thailand ee markii hore la siiyay. Mas'uuliyiintu waxay markaas soo saari doonaan shahaadooyin dhalasho oo cusub oo sax ah. Kuwan waxaa si cad loogu qori doonaa in ilmuhu yahay 'ilmo dhalasho ahaan ka soo jeeda waddan shisheeye', waxaana sidoo kale lagu xusi doonaa dhalashada waalidkooda dhabta ah.
Si kastaba ha ahaatee, lama dafiri karo in nolosha carruurtan ay si lama filaan ah isku beddesho marka la ogaado inay si sharci darro ah ku heleen dhalashada Thailand, xitaa haddii aysan iyagu wax door ah ku lahayn go'aanka loo maray hababkan sharci darrada ah.
Marwo Thianthong Prasaranpanich, oo ah Ku xigeenka Agaasimaha Guud ee Waaxda Arrimaha Carruurta iyo Dhallinyarada ee Wasaaradda Horumarinta Bulshada iyo Amniga Aadanaha (MSDHS), ayaa sheegtay in haddii waalidka ilmaha la xiro, Kooxda Fulinta Sharciga ee Ilaalinta Carruurta ay raadin doonaan qaraabada ilmaha, ayna qiimeyn doonaan awoodda ay u leeyihiin inay daryeelaan ilmaha. Kadib waxaa la diyaarin doonaa heshiis qoraal ah oo ay waalidku ku oggolaanayaan inay ilmaha ku wareejiyaan daryeelka qaraabada. Mas'uuliyiinta Wasaaradda ayaa markaas booqan doona qaraabadaas si ay u hubiyaan in si habboon loo daryeelayo ilmaha.
Ku xigeenka Agaasimaha Guud ee Waaxda Arrimaha Carruurta iyo Dhallinyarada ayaa tiri, "Haddii aan la helin wax qaraabo ah, Wasaaradda Horumarinta Bulshada iyo Amniga Aadanaha waxay diyaar u tahay inay ilmaha daryeelkeeda ku qaadato si ku-meel-gaar ah. Ilmaha waxaa la daryeeli doonaa ilaa laga helayo qaraabadiisa ama inta laga bilaabayo tallaabo sharci oo ka dhan ah waalidkiis."
Ilo xogo gaal u ah kiiskan ayaa u sheegay BBC Thai in maxkamaduhu ay badanaa diidaan inay dammaanad ku sii daayaan dadka ku lugta leh shabakadda loo yaqaan 'father-child spirit' (shabakad si sharci darro ah carruurta ugu xirta rag u dhashay Thailand), maadaama ay kiisaskan u arkaan mid khatar ku ah amniga qaranka.

South Central Ambulance Service has revealed 21 patients died and nine were severely harmed while it was under pressure during the summer heatwave in June.
The incidents followed a huge rise in calls to the service as temperatures across the South soared.
Board papers show it has issued 39 duty of candour letters, part of its legal obligation to be open and transparent in the event of harm or death, to affected patients and families.
Trust chief nurse Prof Helen Young said she was "deeply sorry for the distress and harm" experienced by patients.
The Met Office issued a red extreme heat warning on 22 June, and ambulance service board papers show exceptional pressures across both 999 and 111 services in the following days.
At the time the service was managing a huge spike in call volumes due to a very high number of sick patients.
It declared a critical incident on 25 June and a major incident on 26 June, which was stood down on 28 June.
The service saw its highest ever number of calls waiting overnight on 25 June, when its data centre also overheated.
That resulted in delays to ambulances attending patients and long waits for assessment and treatment.
Analysis by the UK Health Security Agency reported an estimated 2,124 deaths were associated with the June heatwave across the UK.
An overview of the heatwave will be discussed later at the ambulance trust's board meeting at its northern headquarters in Bicester in Oxfordshire.
The trust said delays in ambulance response were the dominant issue behind most of the cases, with 36 related to delays arriving at the scene.
Delayed backup responses also affected three of these cases.
Of the 39 cases, 21 people died, nine resulted in severe harm, six moderate harm, and three were recorded as low or no harm.
The most common conditions were patients with breathing difficulties, patients who were unconscious and falls.
'Unprecedented'
Young said: "I know the impact of these delays was profound for those patients and families waiting for an ambulance.
"We offer our heartfelt condolences to those affected and our sincere apologies where our service did not meet the standard people expected.
"Every patient and family identified through this review was contacted individually, offered an apology and given the opportunity to be involved in our review process.
"It is not yet determined that in all cases the delay experienced was a contributory factor to the patient's death, but we are committed to fully investigate.
"We know this heatwave was unprecedented, but we will use all these experiences to prepare for future heat and weather events."

Johannesburg – South Africa is bracing for a mix of severe thunderstorms, possible flooding, damaging winds and extreme heat on Thursday, with several provinces placed under weather warnings by the South African Weather Service (SAWS).
The country will experience sharply contrasting conditions, with severe storms expected in parts of the interior while very hot conditions persist in several areas.
A yellow Level 4 warning has been issued for severe thunderstorms over Gauteng, the Mpumalanga Highveld, central-southern Limpopo, eastern parts of the Free State and North West, and most of KwaZulu-Natal.
SAWS warned that the storms could result in “flooding and damage to settlements or property”, while strong winds and large amounts of small hail could cause localised disruptions to electricity supplies and communications.
Yellow level 4 warning: Severe thunderstorms
Affected area: Gauteng, Limpopo & Mpumalanga.

The worsening electricity supply situation across several parts of the country has heightened the hardship residents face amid the recent heatwave, Daily Trust reports.
From Lagos to Abuja, Kano, Maiduguri, Ondo State, Kwara, and other states, residents have lamented declining electricity supply, with some reporting outages lasting days or weeks.
The situation has forced many households to adopt uncomfortable and, in some cases, risky measures to survive the heat, while businesses dependent on electricity are counting their losses.
In Lagos, the frustration over persistent blackouts recently spilled onto the streets as residents of Lagos Island staged a protest, demanding an immediate restoration of electricity to their communities.

The demonstration, which took place on Tuesday, involved mainly women from Lewis, Okesuna, Beecroft, Simpson and Sandgrouse streets, who expressed anger over prolonged power outages and the discomfort caused by rising temperatures.
They called on the electricity distribution company to address their plight.
The residents said the absence of electricity had compounded the discomfort caused by intense heat, leaving households struggling to sleep, preserve food and carry out daily activities.
The situation has been attributed in some areas to constraints in power generation and reduced electricity allocation from the national grid.
In August, Eko Electricity Distribution Company (EKEDC) reportedly said its allocation had fallen from 486 megawatts to 347 megawatts, forcing it to adjust electricity supply to some feeders.
The latest demonstration also followed a warning by the Lagos State Government about the possibility of extreme heat as the dry season approaches and the El Niño climate pattern strengthens.
Following the El Nino weather pattern, it has been projected that Nigeria could record an additional 31,400 heat-related deaths between September 2026 and February 2027.
The projection by the Climate Impact Lab places Nigeria among the countries expected to suffer the highest number of additional heat-related deaths globally during the six-month period of El Niño, with nearly half of the 66,800 deaths projected across the Sahel region expected to occur in the country.
However, the combination of high temperatures and unreliable electricity has heightened residents’ concerns, especially over their ability to keep homes comfortable and businesses operating.
The situation is no different on Lagos Mainland, where residents have been without electricity supply for the past few days.
The Ikeja Electricity Distribution Company, which serves the Lagos Mainland and some parts of Ogun State, has been sending apologies to the residents over the blackout.
Daily Trust gathered that most of the areas on Band A, with supply of at least 20 hours of electricity on a daily basis have been getting less than 10 hours in recent times.
A resident of Ojodu, Kehinde Joju, said the supply has been epileptic in recent days. He said he had to buy a solar-powered standing fan because of the heatwaves.
Paul Oyewusi, another Lagos resident, lamented the absence of electricity, describing the situation as unfair, especially during the period of intense heat.
He said residents who previously enjoyed relatively stable electricity supply were now struggling to cope with the prolonged outages.
Abuja residents battle sleepless nights, dehydration
The situation is no different in the Federal Capital Territory (FCT), where residents of several communities have complained about worsening electricity supply, saying the combination of prolonged blackouts and intense heat has made life increasingly unbearable.
Reacting to the persistent epileptic power supply, a resident of Kurudu in the Abuja Municipal Area Council, Usman Nalado, said many households were struggling to cope with almost daily blackouts.
He said some residents had been forced to sleep outside their homes because of the inability to power air conditioners and electric fans.
For Laraba Nura, who lives in the Kpeyegi area, the situation is even worse. She said some of her neighbours had reported dehydration and dizziness due to excessive heat resulting from poor electricity supply.
For residents within the Abuja metropolis, electricity supply has dropped drastically in the last few weeks, worsening the discomfort associated with the prevailing heat.
Michael Eze, a resident of Kpana, said the frustration caused by the intense heatwave being experienced across the country was becoming unbearable.
“I read a report that ‘super El Niño’ is driving significant shifts in temperature and rainfall across Nigeria through late 2026 and early 2027. Government should do something urgently to reduce the effect of the prediction on Nigerians,” he said.
A resident of Utako, who simply identified himself as Abayomi, lamented that erratic electricity supply had also increased water scarcity, while the high cost of fuel had made it difficult for him to cope with the harsh weather conditions.
He said the inability to pump water regularly, alongside the rising cost of alternative energy, had further compounded the challenges facing households.
Ogala Samson, a Jikwoyi resident, said the cost of petrol had made an already difficult situation worse for households, as many could no longer afford to fuel their generators to provide electricity.
Abduljalal Usman Nggu, a resident of Guzape in Abuja, said the problem of electricity supply in Nigeria had become something that people could only pray about.
He added that ordinary Nigerians had yet to experience the improvements being claimed by the government.
“When they say there has been progress, where exactly is that progress? Unless they are simply making statements to defend what is indefensible, I do not see any improvement,” he added.
Kano residents turn to solar, consider alternatives
In Kano, poor public electricity supply is forcing many residents to seek alternative power sources to meet their daily needs.
Although the weather in Kano is relatively mild compared with some other parts of the country, poor electricity supply is taking a toll on households, particularly those that depend on the national grid rather than alternative energy sources.
Aminu Ahmed, a retired public servant, said his neighbourhood had been without public electricity for the last four days, adding that his solar system had helped to fill the gap.
Abdul Jalal Muhammad, another resident, said his water-pumping machine only functioned when there was public electricity supply. However, in the last couple of days, supply had either been epileptic or completely unavailable.
Muhammad said he had exhausted the water in his tank and could no longer pump water because of the electricity shortage.
He said although he had a solar electricity system in his house, it only powered his lighting points, a few fans and a television, leaving him unable to pump water.
He appealed to the Kano Electricity Distribution Company (KEDCO) to address the problem and restore normal supply to Kano to enable residents to enjoy a better quality of life.
For Malam Ladan, a tailor, the disappointment caused by poor electricity supply has prompted him to seek a permanent solution to the power problem.
He noted that buying fuel to power his generator was no longer a cheaper option because of rising fuel prices. He would therefore consider upgrading his solar system to accommodate his sewing machines and other equipment in his shop.
Responding to complaints by consumers, KEDCO’s Head of Corporate Affairs, Sani Bala Sani, said the recent electricity supply shortfall was primarily attributable to gas supply constraints affecting thermal power generation, reduced generation output and transmission network limitations.
These challenges, he explained, had resulted in inadequate power allocation to distribution companies nationwide.
He said the situation in Kano remained challenging as the distribution company continued to experience reduced energy allocation, affecting electricity supply across Kano, Katsina and Jigawa states.
“These challenges have been further compounded by transmission network constraints and recent maintenance activities on critical transmission infrastructure,” he said.
Borno residents lament
In Borno State, residents of various neighbourhoods have expressed frustration over a severe deterioration in electricity supply, with some households reportedly receiving power for only five hours every two days.
The situation has compounded the hardship of living through intense heat, forcing residents to adopt desperate measures to cope with the uncomfortable weather.
Sunday Bitrus, a resident of Abuja New City in Maiduguri, lamented that electricity distribution had dropped drastically.
Bitrus also described how he and his family had to take security risks just to get some ventilation while sleeping at night.
“I normally open my room’s windows and, at times, the door before I could sleep. And it’s very risky in Maiduguri, but we don’t have an option,” he said.
Another resident of Pompomari Bypass, Suleiman Prince, said the epileptic electricity supply, coupled with severe weather conditions, had left residents vulnerable.
“So, those with better financial standing are now installing solar systems in their homes to escape the hardship. It’s not easy to cope with the heat, and everyone is praying for the cold season to set in,” he said.
Another resident, Buhari Lawan, who lives along Damboa Road, linked the sudden drop in electricity supply to the installation of prepaid meters in his area.
Ondo
In Ondo State, residents of several communities also lamented prolonged electricity outages amid the prevailing heatwave, saying the situation has affected their health, sleep and livelihoods.
Oluwasogo Bidemi said residents of some communities in Ondo State were also experiencing prolonged blackouts without any explanation from the Benin Electricity Distribution Company (BEDC).
Bidemi said the situation had affected residents’ ability to preserve food and drinks, adding that those without solar power or inverters were particularly vulnerable because they could not afford alternative sources of electricity.
She urged the government and BEDC to intervene, warning that residents should not have to stage protests before their electricity supply could be restored.
Bidemi said she had resorted to drinking plenty of water to remain hydrated and prevent the heat from aggravating other health challenges.
Dolapo Oguntuase, a small business owner, said the lack of electricity had affected her ability to keep bottled water and drinks cold, despite increased demand for chilled products during the hot weather.
She said customers were less willing to patronise her business when cold drinks were unavailable, adding that the cost of electricity had become increasingly difficult to sustain.
Oguntuase disclosed that she spent more than N20,000 monthly on electricity, despite struggling to recover the cost from sales of drinks alone.
Efforts to reach the Benin Electricity Distribution Company (BEDC), Ondo chapter, over the cause of the recent electricity supply shortage were unsuccessful, as calls and text messages sent to the company were not answered.
Low power generation puts Nigeria in blackout
Daily Trust gathered that Nigeria is currently witnessing lingering blackouts in most of its cities on account of gas shortages to thermal plants, causing a persistent drop in power generation by service providers.
It was gathered that the power plants are getting only 40% of the gas they need to function optimally.
Daily Trust reports that power generation dropped to 3,940MW on Wednesday, which is below the 4000MW required to make it stable.
There are fears that power distribution companies may commence load shedding or power rationing soon in order to manage the scantily available power in their networks.
In a statement, the Transmission Company of Nigeria confirmed that power allocation to distribution companies had dropped due to gas constraints to thermal generation companies.
“TCN is doing everything possible in collaboration with stakeholders in the power sector to ensure that it continues to keep the grid intact despite the current low power generated into the system.
“Consequently, given the current load on the grid, load distributed to the distribution load centres have also reduced, as TCN can only transmit what is generated,” the statement said.
Power distribution companies contacted by Daily Trust also confirmed low allocation on account of gas constraints, and appealed to their customers for understanding pending when it is fixed.
At a recent Nigeria Energy Leadership Summit, in Lagos, Power Minister Joseph Tegbe lamented that gas supply constraints, overstretched transmission infrastructure, distribution losses and N3.3 trillion legacy debts are crippling improved power supply to Nigerians.
He added: “Of an estimated N3.3 trillion owed to operators, N1.23 trillion has been paid, while leakages are being blocked to stop fresh debts.”
A former Power Minister, Prof. Barth Nnaji, said Nigeria had the capacity to generate about 13,000 megawatts, but only between 4,000 and 5,000 megawatts was available on the national grid.
Speaking at a Lagos Country Club Forum, he identified inadequate gas supply and poor transmission infrastructure as major constraints causing businesses to expend about N1.34 trillion on alternative power generation.
An electrical engineer, Yakubu Isa Al-Jasawi, said the progress of any country was closely linked to the amount of energy it consumed, including electricity, gas and other forms of energy.
He said energy consumption remained one of the indicators used to measure the level of development of countries, arguing that Nigeria’s electricity challenges required more than government assurances and official claims of improvement.
According to him, ordinary Nigerians should be the ones to determine whether the country’s energy crisis has been resolved based on their everyday experiences.
He said, “If you examine developed countries, one of the indicators used to measure their level of development is the amount of energy they consume.
“In Nigeria, when we talk about ending the energy crisis, the ordinary Nigerian should be the one to tell us whether the problem has been resolved, not politicians or government officials”.
Al-Jasawi argued that electricity generation was not technically impossible, given the technology available globally, adding that the major challenge was ensuring that generated electricity could be transmitted and distributed to consumers.
“The electricity we are talking about is not technically impossible to generate. It is not particularly difficult to produce electricity with the technology available today.
“You will agree that electricity cannot be generated in Kainji and transported to Jos or Abuja without transmission lines”.
He said the country’s persistent electricity challenges raised questions about the commitment to addressing the crisis, particularly given the investments made in the power sector over the years.
“That is why, given the current situation, one can begin to suspect deliberate sabotage”.
The engineer recalled that some state governments had attempted to establish their own electricity generation projects during the administration of former President Olusegun Obasanjo, with substantial investments made in projects that had considerable generation capacity.
“There were states that attempted to establish their own electricity generation projects as far back as the administration of former President Olusegun Obasanjo. They invested substantial amounts of money, and some of those projects had considerable generation capacity”.
He called for a more decentralised approach to electricity generation, urging the government to encourage Nigerians, including students, to acquire the knowledge and skills required to generate electricity.
“What we want now is for people, including students in every local government area, to be taught how to generate electricity”.
He also cited the increasing adoption of solar energy in Kano, saying the growing reliance on alternative energy sources reflected declining public confidence in government electricity supply.
“If you look at Kano city today, you will discover that almost half of the electricity being used in some areas comes from solar energy because people have gradually lost confidence in the government,” he said.

CEBU City Mayor Nestor Archival wants to consult school officials on possible alternatives to suspending face-to-face classes during extreme heat, raising questions about how schools can protect students while minimizing disruptions to their learning.
Archival said on Wednesday, Nov. 4, 2026, that he wanted to revisit existing heat-response measures with school administrators, particularly whether class suspensions should be the immediate response when heat-index thresholds are reached.
“Gusto nako ma-balik og meeting ang mga eskwelahan,” Archival said in an interview.
(I want to meet with the schools again.)
He cited heat-index levels of 33 to 41 degrees Celsius and 42 degrees and above, which fall under different intervention categories in the Department of Education’s (DepEd) guidelines.
While acknowledging that existing rules prescribe different responses depending on heat conditions, Archival questioned whether suspending in-person classes should automatically be the first option.
DepEd heat rules
Archival issued the statement as DepEd implements a four-level framework to protect learners from extreme heat and the anticipated effects of the expected super El Niño phenomenon during School Year 2026–2027.
Under DepEd Memorandum 064, Series of 2026, the 4H Learning Modality Framework prescribes different responses based on the heat index, with schools authorized to adjust schedules and learning arrangements according to prevailing conditions.
At the Hayo level, when the heat index is below 27 degrees Celsius, regular face-to-face classes may continue with precautions such as hydration breaks and improved ventilation.
Under Hinay, covering 27 to 32 degrees Celsius, schools may shorten class hours, adjust schedules or adopt hybrid and home-based learning.
At Hinga, or 33 to 41 degrees Celsius, face-to-face classes must be suspended, with schools shifting to lighter home-based learning activities.
The highest level, Hinto, applies at 42 degrees Celsius and above, when all academic activities, including home-based learning, must stop to prioritize safety.
School heads are responsible for determining appropriate arrangements based on conditions in their schools, in coordination with their Schools Division Offices.
New suspension policy
President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. earlier issued Executive Order 130, establishing a unified framework for suspending and resuming classes and school activities.
The order allows schools to suspend in-person activities when conditions threaten the safety or health of learners and personnel, subject to coordination with local authorities.
Schools may also seek earlier resumption of face-to-face classes during a localized suspension if safety assessments support the move and the local chief executive agrees.
DepEd has been directed to issue implementing guidelines, including specific hazard thresholds and suspension procedures, within 30 days from the order’s effectivity.
EO 130 emphasizes that suspending face-to-face classes does not necessarily mean stopping learning, with schools expected to implement alternative arrangements whenever feasible.
Archival has yet to clarify how the alternatives he wants schools to consider would operate within the existing DepEd guidelines. / CAV

Zimbabweans have been urged to protect themselves as extreme temperatures increase the risk of serious health complications.
The Ministry of Health and Child Care has issued a public warning about the dangers of prolonged heat exposure.
In an advisory released on Thursday, 5 November, the ministry highlighted the health risks associated with the current hot conditions.
It warned that intense sunlight, high temperatures and demanding physical activities could overwhelm the body’s cooling system.
Consequently, people exposed to excessive heat could develop dehydration, heat exhaustion or heatstroke.
Health officials described heatstroke as a potentially life-threatening emergency requiring urgent medical attention.
The warning also comes ahead of a challenging 2026/2027 rainfall season.
Zimbabwe’s seasonal climate outlook points towards below-normal rainfall and above-normal temperatures.
The ministry linked these conditions to the expected influence of El Niño.
“The 2026/2027 seasonal climate outlook indicates the likelihood of below-normal rainfall and warmer-than-normal temperatures associated with El Niño conditions, potentially increasing heat exposure and water stress,” the ministry said.
Children, Elderly People and Outdoor Workers Face Greater Risks
Although extreme heat can affect anyone, health officials identified several particularly vulnerable groups.
These include young children, elderly people and pregnant women.
People with chronic illnesses and persons with disabilities also face increased risks.
Meanwhile, workers who spend extended periods outdoors must exercise additional caution.
This group includes farmers, construction workers and street vendors.
Their exposure to direct sunlight and physically demanding activities increases their vulnerability.
The ministry’s warning highlights the importance of taking precautions as temperatures rise.
Zimbabweans should remain alert to heat-related illnesses throughout the coming months.

Record-Breaking Price Movement
On 5 November 2026, ICICI Bank’s share price surged to Rs 1,498.75, surpassing its previous 52-week high and setting a fresh benchmark. The stock opened with a gap up of 2.53% and closed the day with a gain of 5.34%, outperforming the private banking sector’s 3.58% rise and the Sensex’s 2.68% advance. Intraday, the stock touched a high of Rs 1,498.75, demonstrating strong buying momentum throughout the session.
Notably, ICICI Bank’s price is trading above all key moving averages, including the 5-day, 20-day, 50-day, 100-day, and 200-day averages, signalling a sustained upward trend. This technical strength complements the fundamental performance that has driven the stock to this historic level.
Consistent Outperformance Against Benchmarks
ICICI Bank’s recent price action is part of a broader pattern of market-beating returns. Over the past one year, the stock has delivered a 12.23% return, significantly outperforming the Sensex, which declined by 4.90% during the same period. Year-to-date, the bank’s shares have risen by 11.70%, while the Sensex fell 6.86%.
Longer-term performance is even more impressive. Over three years, ICICI Bank’s stock has appreciated by 60.69%, nearly triple the Sensex’s 23.32% gain. Over five years, the stock has nearly doubled with a 91.72% increase, compared to the Sensex’s 32.14%. The ten-year return stands at a remarkable 511.80%, underscoring the bank’s sustained growth and value creation for shareholders.
Strong Financial Fundamentals Underpinning Growth
ICICI Bank’s ascent to an all-time high is supported by solid financial metrics and operational strength. The bank maintains an average Return on Assets (ROA) of 2.11%, reflecting efficient utilisation of its asset base. Net profit has grown at an annualised rate of 22.94%, highlighting consistent earnings expansion over the years.
Capital adequacy remains robust, with a Capital Adequacy Ratio of 15.46%, indicating a strong buffer against credit and market risks. This level of capitalisation is well above regulatory requirements and provides a cushion for future growth and stability.
Recent Quarterly Highlights
The bank has reported positive results for three consecutive quarters, reinforcing its growth trajectory. Key quarterly metrics include a Gross Non-Performing Asset (NPA) ratio at a low 1.20%, the lowest in recent periods, and a Net Interest Income (NII) reaching a record high of Rs 25,338.69 crores. Additionally, the bank declared its highest annual dividend per share of Rs 12.00, reflecting strong cash flow and shareholder returns.
Other notable quarterly figures include interest earned of Rs 49,110.00 crores, Profit Before Depreciation, Interest and Tax (Pbdit) of Rs 12,527.74 crores, and Profit After Tax (PAT) of Rs 14,843.03 crores. The bank’s credit-deposit ratio stands at a healthy 89.35%, indicating balanced growth in lending relative to deposits.
Market Position and Sector Influence
With a market capitalisation of Rs 10,22,587 crores, ICICI Bank is the second-largest company in the private banking sector, trailing only HDFC Bank. It accounts for 28.83% of the sector’s total market capitalisation, underscoring its dominant position. The bank’s annual sales of Rs 180,022.01 crores represent 18.14% of the industry, further highlighting its scale and influence.
Institutional investors hold a significant 92.44% stake in the bank, reflecting confidence from well-resourced market participants who closely analyse the company’s fundamentals.
Valuation and Technical Assessment

Key support levels include the 52-week low of Rs 1,187.55, while resistance points are noted around the 20-day and 100-day moving averages at Rs 1,381.79 and Rs 1,392.36 respectively. The recent surge beyond these levels culminated in the new all-time high.
Quality and Risk Considerations
ICICI Bank is rated as an excellent quality company based on long-term financial performance. Management risk, growth prospects, and capital structure all receive excellent grades. The bank maintains a low net debt to equity ratio of zero, indicating minimal leverage and a strong balance sheet.
While the bank’s valuation is on the higher side compared to historical averages and peers, this is supported by its consistent earnings growth and market leadership. The PEG ratio of 1.9 reflects a valuation premium relative to profit growth of 10.3% over the past year, which investors may consider in their assessment of the stock’s price levels.
Summary

The certificate of entitlement (COE) premium for Category A – meant for smaller, less powerful cars and electric vehicles (EVs) – rose by 5.3 per cent to an all-time high of S$139,001 on Nov 4, eclipsing the previous record of $133,009 set on Sept 9.
This also marks the first time that the COE price for Category A has outstripped that of Category E.
Category B COE premiums – used to register larger, more powerful cars and EVs – also increased, but more modestly, from S$131,901 to S$132,334 – a 0.3% rise.
The only other COE category to post an increase in prices was for Category E or the Open category.
It increased by 0.2%, from S$135,790 to S$135,998.
Open category certificates are transferable and can be used to register any vehicle type except motorcycles. Motor traders often secure them for the flexibility to register cars without waiting for the next tender exercise.
The price of a commercial vehicle certificate dipped by 0.2% from S$92,200 to S$92,000.
Motorcycle COEs closed at S$10,689 – 0.8% lower than the S$10,778 at the previous exercise.
After the close of the tender exercise, a spokesperson for the Land Transport Authority said COE prices remain elevated, likely due to strong demand for mass-market EVs that qualify under Category A, as well as the Car Expo held on Oct 24 and 25.
“We urge buyers and dealers to be prudent in bidding for COEs,” the spokesperson added.
The latest COE results come after LTA closed its public consultation exercise on COE categorisation on Nov 2.
The exercise was to gather feedback on a proposed review of the COE system, which is expected to be completed by the first half of 2027.
Besides proposing a merger of the two car categories, other suggested changes include a fee and rebate system, in which buyers of higher-value cars will pay higher premiums compared with those who purchase mass-market options.
Chong Kah Wei, managing director of BMW Eurokars, said there was a sense among car dealers that COE premiums for Category A would increase.
However, the record high prices for Category A came as a surprise to him.
The Car Expo, he added, was the likely driver behind the spike in prices, with 2,018 bids placed for 1,189 Category A COEs that were available.
With the COE review also looming, Chong said it is likely that people were rushing into the market ahead of any changes that could come in the future.
“I don’t think prices are going to come down significantly, but we might see people shifting from Category A to Category B in the next exercise, considering the difference in prices,” he added.
Raymond Ng, managing director of Eurokars EV, which distributes the Chinese brands MG and IM Motors, said buyers were also swayed by the upcoming rollback of incentives for EV adoption, starting in January 2027.
EV buyers now qualify for a combined rebate of up to S$30,000, but it will go down to S$20,000 from 2027.
Mr Ng said: “After today, there’s going to be only three COE bidding exercises left. You’ve got dealers dangling these EV rebates, as well as LTA dangling COE recategorisation.
“All this is just driving people to buy now because there’s more certainty, and they also know they can save S$10,000 if they opt for an EV.” THE STRAITS TIMES

BHUBANESWAR: Chief Minister Mohan Charan Majhi on Wednesday met Union Home and Cooperation minister Amit Shah in New Delhi and discussed the post-cyclone situation in the state, ongoing relief and restoration measures and long-term strategies to strengthen disaster management infrastructure.
The meeting took place on the second day of Majhi’s two-day visit to the national capital. The chief minister had attended the Bharat Renewable Energy Summit and Exhibition 2026 on Tuesday.
In a post on X, Majhi said he had a courtesy meeting with Shah during his Delhi visit. They held detailed discussions on the situation following the recent cyclone, relief and rehabilitation measures and strengthening infrastructure to ensure a more effective and sustainable response to natural disasters in the coming years.
Majhi also expressed gratitude to the Union minister for the Centre’s prompt assistance and continued cooperation in disaster management.
The meeting assumes significance as Odisha continues its post-cyclone restoration and relief operations following cyclone Arnab which affected several districts of the state. The state government has announced a relief package for affected families and farmers, while restoration of essential services and assessment of damage are also underway.
